owner.title: Shop Owner & Staff Portal
owner.subtitle: Restricted to authorized mart operators

customer.subtitle: For registered farmers and retail buyers

ownerLogin.title: Shop Owner & Staff Login
ownerLogin.notice: Authentication system is scheduled for Milestone 4.
ownerLogin.description: This route serves as the access point for the Shop Owner and authorized counter staff. Role-based JWT security and session encryption will be activated in the upcoming milestone.
plannedItems: Separate permission levels for counter staff vs owner
Session timeout and audit trail registration

customerLogin.title: Farmer & Customer Portal Login
customerLogin.notice: Customer authentication is scheduled for Milestone 4.
customerLogin.description: This route will allow registered farmers to log in using their registered mobile number to securely view their own purchase history and credit balance without access to any internal store financials.
plannedItems: Zero-leakage data isolation (customers only see their own records)
